name: Shadowy Disguise (Fetchling)
body:
The disguise you don is made of shadow magic, making it partially real.

Prerequisite: Fetchling, disguise self spell-like ability

Benefit: You can use disguise self an additional time each day. When you use your disguise self spell-like ability, the disguise is partially made real with shadowstuff, letting it actually alter the tactile (touch) or audible (sound) properties of you and your equipment.

Normal: Disguise self cannot alter the perceived tactile or audible properties of you or your equipment.
